prompts.skills_01: Use case: illustration. Asset type: 16-bit pixel-art skill-icon atlas for an Eternal Return fan deck-building game. Create a NEW pixel reinterpretation of all occupied reference icons in EXACTLY their same row-major order; use only the little square skill pictures as visual references, never copy the surrounding labels or Korean names. CRITICAL GRID: exactly FIVE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 20 cells total, landscape canvas with a 5:4 aspect ratio. No extra cells, no missing occupied cells, no collage drift. Each tile contains one complete centered icon, large and clearly readable at 64-96px. Give all cells a consistent dark charcoal/navy opaque background. Each pictogram and colored action burst stays wholly inside its own tile with a small empty margin, never crosses a boundary. Preserve each source skill's recognizable main shape, action direction, silhouette, distinctive element, composition and dominant colors. Redraw as HARD EDGED CHUNKY PIXEL ART: clearly visible square pixel clusters, stepped contour, limited 16-bit palette, simple two-three-tone shading and high contrast; simple cute game-readable symbols, no smooth antialiasing, no blurry glow, no gradients, no photorealistic rendering. Every skill must have its OWN distinct icon; do not reuse one icon for several cells. No card frames, no characters outside tiles, no printed cell identifiers, no titles, no labels, no watermarks. Only if the skill's actual symbol is lettering, such as Nia's KO and 1UP, keep that intrinsic minimal pixel lettering; otherwise NO TEXT. Fill the canvas with the ordered tile grid. Reference rows exactly: row 1 Nia, row 2 Jackie, row 3 Aya, row 4 Hyunwoo. Columns exactly T, Q, W, E, R. There are TWENTY occupied icons. Nia row: magenta KO burst, bright magenta arcade button with star on top, magenta directional arcade joystick/button, pink 1UP upward revival block, purple isometric virtual game grid. Jackie row: enraged fiery silhouette, arcing orange slash, bloody red axe, leaping figure striking ground, close-up chainsaw blade. Aya row: cyan/gold justice shot silhouette, two speeding bullets, purple figure firing multiple bullets, cyan black/white running silhouettes, black pistol pointing upward with gold muzzle flash. Hyunwoo row: determined red-haired face, stomping red shoe with orange crescent, blue tough figure with radiating shield rays, rushing black figure on cyan speed lines, giant golden impact fist. Please retain these distinct reference symbols and the same positions. No outer labels or character names.

Its central seal must resemble the white curved Chinese-style talisman strokes in Image 2's Hyejin W tile, with the same blue rectangular paper, white-blue border, tilt, cyan-white seal glyph and radiating dark-blue rays.
